## File: berriai_litellm/litellm/llms/gemini/files/transformation.py

Prompts

```
['create a Gemini resumable file upload request with headers and metadata from an OpenAI-style file creation request', 'create an OpenAI-style FileObject from a Gemini file upload API response', 'build a Gemini API URL to retrieve a file by normalizing its file identifier', 'create an OpenAI-style FileObject from a Gemini file retrieval API response with state mapping', 'build a Gemini API DELETE URL for removing a file by URI']
```

Usage

```
{'create_file_upload_request': 'create a Gemini resumable file upload request with headers and metadata from an OpenAI-style file creation request', 'create_file_response': 'create an OpenAI-style FileObject from a Gemini file upload API response', 'retrieve_file_request': 'build a Gemini API URL to retrieve a file by normalizing its file identifier', 'retrieve_file_response': 'create an OpenAI-style FileObject from a Gemini file retrieval API response with state mapping', 'delete_file_request': 'build a Gemini API DELETE URL for removing a file by URI'}
```
